agentConnectedDescription: {client} authorized Genfeed and completed its first MCP request.

browserDescription: Add Genfeed in your client, then approve access in the browser. No API key is needed.

emptyKeys: No active Genfeed API keys yet.

keyTitle: 2. Create or select a scoped key

storedKeyLabel: Stored value for the selected key
title: Connect Genfeed
